title: 2017 HMMT November Guts Problem 14
statement: Points \(A, B, C\), and \(D\) lie on a line in that order such that \(\frac{A B}{B C}=\frac{D A}{C D}\). If \(A C=3\) and \(B D=4\), find \(A D\).

solutions.text:
Answer: 6
Let \(B C=x\), then the equation becomes \(\frac{3-x}{x}=\frac{7-x}{4-x}\). This simplifies to a quadratic equation with solutions \(x=1\) and \(x=6\). Since \(x<3\), we have \(x=1\) and \(A D=7-x=6\).
